Flag an item only if some option upholds every standard, if the text states which option ought to be chosen beyond the stipulated facts, or if it names a psychological construct or reveals a study hypothesis. Do not accept merely because the design could show an effect. Return only JSON with verdict accept/revise/reject, blocking_issues list, limits list. Under 150 words.
